name: Echoes of the Heart
passiveDesc: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by 60/75/90/105/120 for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by 16/20/24/28/32% for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
description: A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.

modifiers.label: Elemental Mastery after an Elemental Reaction
Stellar Glimmer DMG after triggering Stellar Glimmer
